name: Museum of Craft and Design
description: The Museum of Craft and Design (MCD) in San Francisco's Dogpatch neighborhood explores the creative process through contemporary craft and design. It's the only museum in San Francisco devoted exclusively to craft and design.
fullDescription: The Museum of Craft and Design (MCD) in San Francisco's Dogpatch neighborhood explores the creative process through contemporary craft and design. It's the only museum in San Francisco devoted exclusively to craft and design.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free First Thursdays: Free admission for everyone on the first Thursday of the month
- EBT cardholders: Free admission
- SF Museums for All: Medi-Cal or CalFresh recipients get 4 free admission passes per visit
- Active-duty military, veterans, first responders, and their families: Free
- Children through age 12: Free
- Students with ID and seniors (65+): $8
- General admission: $10
howToGetIt: Show your EBT, Medi-Cal, or CalFresh card, military or first responder ID, student ID, or proof of age at the front desk. Tickets are sold at the museum or online up to 60 days ahead; reserving is encouraged but not required. Open Thursday through Sunday, 12 to 5 p.m.
